product_build.toolchain_features_flags: not independently attested for distributed binary

metrics.browser_reload: paired in-app browser; running city; warm cache; 1440x900; DOM input echo checked; automation overhead included
metrics.first_read_and_create: first file tool cycle in each fresh process/project; cache warm; 1024 bytes; exact bytes checked
metrics.ax_cycle: fixed tool arguments emitted to next model request containing actual tool result; includes scheduling, serialization and loopback
metrics.ax_groups: three independent groups per agent/action; first action separate, 200 following actions each
metrics.ram: Windows PrivateUsage; 20 fixed history turns; 15s idle and 15s fixed-provider active waiting; 100ms samples
metrics.ram_rows: per-cohort time-window summary, not raw time-series samples or independent-run quantiles
metrics.io: observed process-tree counter increments, not physical disk throughput
metrics.task_time: runner startup through termination; includes model/provider and tools; no task P99

workload.coding_contract: modify only solution.py; preserve inputs and other files; check type distinctions, mutation and aliasing

gpt.native_instructions_and_tools: retained; Codex code_mode_only; default relay instructions can differ
gpt.sprawling_compatibility: gateway removes only unsupported prompt_cache_breakpoint; native preflight returned HTTP400

publication_boundary: Only numerical observations, outcome records and necessary conditions; no provider credentials, prompts, conversations or personal paths
reproducibility_boundary: verify.py recalculates the exported measurements; this subset does not include live-provider runners, generated task artifacts or raw memory time series
